report:
Reviewed the entire schedule_independence claim, ordinary merge implementation, explicit implementation TODO and both tests; captured the solver design, resource/scheduling RFD and hint-merging helper. Source inspection only; no behavioral tests rerun and no source changes.

The claim fixes canonical semantic inputs/limits and permits differing discovery/cancellation/trace/work/memory while requiring identical answer class, output, substitutions, residuals, hints, response numbering and overflow distinctions/kinds. merge_candidate_results sorts and deduplicates canonical candidate values before its rules, retains an unconditional empty-substitution Proven result regardless of other alternatives, eliminates dominated Yes responses, distinguishes complete empty absence from incomplete sources and merges remaining possibilities through conservative hints. This provides deterministic processing of an already available answer set; it is not a full guarantee that all scheduler/resource executions produce that same set or canonically numbered outputs.

The ordinary final_answer_rules_are_order_independent test builds actual No, empty-hint Maybe and unconditional Proven responses using in-file constructors. Three permutations of those responses must equal the entire unconditional Stashed result, not merely share its enum variant. Additional duplicate-Maybe and duplicate-No inputs must remain Maybe and No respectively. It is meaningful coverage of the simple final-answer rules and duplicate handling, but contains no type output, nonempty substitution/residual/hint/binder, scheduler perturbation, cancellation or resource exhaustion.

The associated implementation TODO explicitly states deterministic resource accounting and scheduler perturbation guarantees remain planned. The solver_schedule_independence TODO test calls for perturbed ready queues yielding byte-identical results for proof, normalization, residual, ambiguity and every overflow case, allowing only nonsemantic trace order to differ. Completing the resource taxonomy/accounting and that perturbation matrix is prerequisite to the full claim, including all enumerated output fields and response numbering. Both TODOs remain visibly deferred; sorting candidate inputs is not substituted for the missing end-to-end guarantee. All requirements and evidence entries are accounted for, no concrete additional defect was identified in the inspected merge slice and no edits are requested.
